description_en: Simulates the impact of logical model modifications
description_zh: 预演逻辑模型修改影响
kebab_example: aliyun apig preview-logical-model-update --logical-model-id vm-d00000000000000000000 --name beta-chat --routing-policy Weighted --targets '[{"modelCardId":"msc-d00000000000000000000","weight":1}]' --fallback-targets '[{"modelCardId":"msc-d00000000000000000000"}]' --response-model Actual --api-version 2024-03-27 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PreviewLogicalModelUpdate

parameters.help_en: The logical model ID. Use the vm- identifier returned by the API
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑模型 ID，使用接口返回的 vm- 标识
parameters.name: logical_model_id

parameters.help_en: The call strategy, which is required for new Auto write requests. Valid values: balanced, cheap, fast, and quality. The new version uses only the basic call name. Do not submit this parameter for Mapping or Weighted. The server performs conditional validation
parameters.help_zh: Auto新写请求必填：balanced、cheap、fast或quality；新版仅使用基础调用名；Mapping/Weighted不得提交；服务端执行条件校验
parameters.name: call_strategy

fields.help_en: The actual source card ID within the same instance
fields.name: model_card_id

parameters.help_en: An ordered list of up to 5 fallback targets. The targets are deduplicated by the actual card ID. This can be an empty array
parameters.help_zh: 有序备用最多5个；按实际卡ID去重，可为空数组
parameters.name: fallback_targets

parameters.help_en: The client logical call name. The value can be up to 256 bytes in UTF-8 encoding, must not contain spaces or slashes, and must not start with auto
parameters.help_zh: 客户端逻辑调用名，UTF-8最多256字节，不含空白或斜杠，不以auto开头
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The response model type. If set to Actual, the public name of the actual model is returned. If set to Logical, the entry name is returned, including SSE
parameters.help_zh: Actual返回实际模型公开名，Logical返回入口名，含SSE
parameters.name: response_model

parameters.help_en: The routing policy. Valid values: Mapping, Weighted, and Auto. If you set this parameter to Auto, targets must be an empty array and slots is required
parameters.name: routing_policy

fields.help_en: The actual source card ID within the same instance, which starts with msc-. VM or service overrides are not supported
fields.help_zh: 同实例实际源卡ID，msc-；不支持VM或服务覆盖
fields.name: model_card_id

fields.help_en: The complex slot, which requires 1 to 3 source cards. Cards across the three slots are globally deduplicated by modelCardId
fields.help_zh: complex槽1至3张源卡；三槽按modelCardId全局去重
fields.name: complex

fields.help_en: The actual source card ID within the same instance, which starts with msc-. VM or service overrides are not supported
fields.help_zh: 同实例实际源卡ID，msc-；不支持VM或服务覆盖
fields.name: model_card_id

fields.help_en: The simple slot, which requires 1 to 3 source cards. Cards across the three slots are globally deduplicated by modelCardId
fields.help_zh: simple槽1至3张源卡；三槽按modelCardId全局去重
fields.name: simple

fields.help_en: The actual source card ID within the same instance, which starts with msc-. VM or service overrides are not supported
fields.help_zh: 同实例实际源卡ID，msc-；不支持VM或服务覆盖
fields.name: model_card_id

fields.help_en: The standard slot, which requires 1 to 3 source cards. Cards across the three slots are globally deduplicated by modelCardId
fields.help_zh: standard槽1至3张源卡；三槽按modelCardId全局去重
fields.name: standard

parameters.help_en: The slots configuration, which is submitted only for Auto. Each of the simple, standard, and complex slots requires 1 to 3 source cards. Cards across the three slots are globally deduplicated by modelCardId. Omit this parameter for Mapping or Weighted
parameters.help_zh: 仅Auto提交；simple/standard/complex各1至3张源卡，三槽按modelCardId全局去重；Mapping/Weighted省略
parameters.name: slots

fields.help_en: The actual source model card ID within the same instance, which starts with msc-. VM or service overrides are not supported
fields.help_zh: 同实例实际源模型卡ID，msc-；不支持VM或服务覆盖
fields.name: model_card_id

fields.help_en: The weight value. Valid values: integers from 0 to 10000. The original value is preserved. For Mapping, 0 is allowed
fields.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The primary targets. For Mapping, exactly one item is required. For Weighted, the sum of the original relative weights must be greater than 0. For Auto, this must be an empty array
parameters.help_zh: 主目标；Mapping恰好一项，Weighted原始相对权重总值大于0，Auto必须为空数组
parameters.name: targets

code.description_en: The response status code. Ok is returned for successful requests, and a specific business error code is returned for failed requests
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the logical model operation
data.description_zh: 逻辑模型操作返回的业务结果

apis.description_en: The list of impacted items, not the delivery result

configuration.description_en: The configuration status. Valid values: Draft and Published

errors.description_en: The blocking reasons, excluding the API publishing results
errors.description_zh: 阻断原因，不含API发布结果

items.description_en: The description of a configuration preview issue
items.description_zh: 一项配置预演问题的说明

errors.title_en: 阻断原因，不含API发布结果
errors.title_zh: 阻断原因，不含API发布结果

revision.description_en: The revision of the successfully published reference

confirmationToken.description_en: A one-time confirmation token that is bound to the configuration and its dependencies or references. If any changes occur, a new preview is required
confirmationToken.description_zh: 单次确认令牌，绑定配置及依赖/引用；变化重新预演

confirmationToken.title_zh: 单次确认令牌，绑定配置及依赖/引用；变化重新预演

revision.title_zh: 用于最终条件写的对象revision

message.description_en: The response message, which describes the result of the request
message.description_zh: 响应消息，用于说明请求处理结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is generated by the system to trace the call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request configuration for the current operation on the logical model
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 逻辑模型的本次操作请求配置
